verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas's cloud Editor offers built-in real-time multi-user editing with no merge conflicts and checkpoint/rollback snapshots (playcanvas-docs-4, -5, -24-26), satisfying the 'built-in collaboration' arm of the story, and a scriptable Editor API/REST access exists for tooling automation (playcanvas-docs-9, -27, -30). However there is no evidence of a diffable/mergeable text scene format, and community reports explicitly flag difficulty using your own source control and lack of a proper local dev workflow (playcanvas-comm-3, -8, -11, -12), with third-party sync tools needed as a workaround (playcanvas-comm-10). missing for 10: native text-based/diffable scene format, first-party git integration, and resolution of community-reported friction with external version control.
